tools.name: wobaka_list_contacts
tools.description: List active contacts (or archived ones with show_archived). Filter by search text, status, owner, tags, or company vs person. Wobaka API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: wobaka_get_contact
tools.description: Show one contact with its custom attributes and related contacts. Wobaka API: GET /contacts/:id.

tools.name: wobaka_get_contact_feed
tools.description: Show the timeline of one contact: notes, messages, emails, automation messages and actions, each with a type field. Wobaka API: GET /contacts/:id/feed.

tools.name: wobaka_list_contact_notes
tools.description: List all notes on one contact, oldest first (not paginated). Wobaka API: GET /contacts/:id/notes.

tools.name: wobaka_list_tasks
tools.description: List open tasks (or completed ones with show_done) across the company. Filter by assignee or search text. Wobaka API: GET /tasks.

tools.name: wobaka_list_contact_tasks
tools.description: List all tasks for one contact, newest first (not paginated). Wobaka API: GET /contacts/:id/tasks.

tools.name: wobaka_get_company
tools.description: Show the company name and id of the account this key belongs to. Wobaka API: GET /company.

tools.name: wobaka_list_members
tools.description: List the company members (active and inactive) with their ids, for owner and assignee fields (not paginated). Wobaka API: GET /members.

tools.name: wobaka_list_statuses
tools.description: List the contact statuses in display order, for status_id fields (not paginated). Wobaka API: GET /statuses.

tools.name: wobaka_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines with their stages in order (not paginated). Use a stage id, not a pipeline id, when creating an opportunity. Wobaka API: GET /pipelines.

tools.name: wobaka_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact owned by the key's user. A person contact needs a first name, last name, email, or company; a company contact needs company. Wobaka API: POST /contacts.

tools.name: wobaka_update_contact
tools.description: Change the given fields of one contact. The tool reads the contact first and keeps every field you do not pass, because Wobaka replaces the whole contact on update. Wobaka API: GET then PUT /contacts/:id.

tools.name: wobaka_create_task
tools.description: Create a task assigned to a company member, optionally linked to a contact. Wobaka API: POST /tasks.

tools.name: wobaka_create_note
tools.description: Add a note to one contact; the author and timestamps are set by Wobaka. Wobaka API: POST /notes.

tools.name: wobaka_create_opportunity
tools.description: Create a sales opportunity on a contact in a pipeline stage. The contact, stage and assignee must belong to the company. Wobaka API: POST /opportunities.

tools.name: wobaka_update_opportunity
tools.description: Change the given fields of one opportunity (for example move it to another stage). Fields you do not pass are kept. Set archived_at to mark it lost; set it to null to restore it. Wobaka API: PUT /opportunities/:id.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wobaka_get_contact_feed · Private data: wobaka_list_contacts, wobaka_get_contact, wobaka_get_contact_feed, wobaka_list_contact_notes, wobaka_list_contact_tasks, wobaka_list_statuses, wobaka_create_contact, wobaka_update_contact, wobaka_create_task, wobaka_create_note, wobaka_create_opportunity · Public sink: wobaka_create_contact, wobaka_create_task, wobaka_create_note, wobaka_create_opportunity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wobaka_get_contact_feed · Private data: wobaka_list_contacts, wobaka_get_contact, wobaka_get_contact_feed, wobaka_list_contact_notes, wobaka_list_contact_tasks, wobaka_list_statuses, wobaka_create_contact, wobaka_update_contact, wobaka_create_task, wobaka_create_note, wobaka_create_opportunity · Public sink: wobaka_create_contact, wobaka_create_task, wobaka_create_note, wobaka_create_opportunity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
